title: Calls: screen pop, softphone, recordings and minutes

scenes.title: Calls, inside the CRM
scenes.subtitle: Answer, talk, note and follow up in one place
scenes.narration: Phone calls are part of every booking. With calling switched on, your team answers and places calls right inside TravelCRM Pro.

scenes.title: UK, US, Australia, Singapore
scenes.subtitle: Calls in this film are played by the local call simulator
scenes.narration: Calling is offered to agencies in the UK, the US, Australia and Singapore, on every paid plan. The calls here are played by the local test simulator, through the same steps a real call takes.
The phone rings, and before you answer you see who it is: the customer's name, their number and their open lead.
Answer in the app. The call panel keeps time, mutes and holds, and takes notes while you talk. Hang up, and the notes are saved with the call.
To call a customer, press Call on their lead. The number and the lead are filled in, the app rings you first, then the customer.
Every call is in the call log: inbound and outbound, answered and missed. Open one to set the outcome.
Recorded calls are kept in your own storage and play from the call page. Transcripts can be added too, charged to your AI allowance; the one shown here was prepared for this demo.
Call analytics show volumes, answer rates and your busiest callers.
Admins set business hours and voicemail, ask callers for consent before recording, choose how long recordings are kept, and rent local numbers. Each agency has its own calling account.
Minutes are counted against the plan's monthly allowance, and outbound calls to unusual or costly destinations are blocked to protect you from toll fraud.
